ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p35/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p35/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p35/r4.claim: After describing the believers' destination, the text contrasts the disbelievers in Hell, confirming that the three inherited classes enter Paradise; their not being killed means they are denied death and its release from sensation.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p35/r4.anchor: لما ذكر حال المؤمنين ومقرهم، ذكر حال الكافرين، وهذا يدل على أن أولئك الثلاثة هم في الجنة،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p35/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p35/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p35/r5.claim: The majority read فيموتوا with the n deleted as a result clause after negation: since they are not put to death, they do not die; it does not mean they come without dying.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p35/r5.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور: فيموتوا، بحذف النون منصوبا في جواب النفي،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r1.claim: The damned are not put to death and do not die, so their punishment continues without relief.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r1.anchor: لا يقضى عليهم ميتين، إنما يقضى عليهم ولا يموتون

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r2.speaker: عيسى، والحسن
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r2.claim: They read «فيموتون» with nūn, coordinating it with «لا يقضى»; Ibn ʿAṭiyya calls this reading weak.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r3.speaker: أبو عثمان المازني
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r3.claim: He takes the coordination to mean they do not die, paralleling the denied permission to apologize; their punishment is not eased.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r3.anchor: وقال أبو عثمان المازني: هو عطف، أي فلا يموتون

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r4.speaker: ابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r4.claim: ʿAbd al-Wārith’s reading from Abū ʿAmr leaves the fāʾ of «يخفف» unvowelled, treating a separated form like a connected one; he cites poetry.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r4.anchor: وقرأ عبد الوارث عن أبي عمرو: ولا يخفف بإسكان الفاء

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r5.speaker: الجمهور
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r5.claim: Most read «نَجزي كل» actively, with «كل» accusative; Abū ʿAmr and Abū Ḥātim from Nāfiʿ read it passively, with «كل» nominative.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p36/r5.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور: نجزي كل، مبنيا للفاعل، ونصب كل

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p424#2/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p424#2/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p424#2/r2.claim: The disbelievers are not killed to gain relief; alternatively, death is not decreed for them.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p424#2/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p424#2/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p424#2/r3.claim: Abū ʿAmr reads يُجزى in passive with “every” nominative; the other readers use first-person plural and make “every” accusative.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r1.claim: The pronoun in ‘its punishment’ refers to Hell, encompassing both fire and the reported punishment of intense cold, zamharīr.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r1.anchor: وضمير { عذابها } عائد إلى جهنم ليشمل ما ورد من أن المعذبين يعذبون بالنار ويعذبون بالزمهرير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r2.claim: Kathālika functions as an absolute object of najzī: God requites them with such a requital; the phrase about every ungrateful disbeliever is a concluding generalization.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r2.anchor: ووقع { كذلك } موقع المفعول المطلق لقوله : { نجزي } أي نجزيهم جزاء كذلك الجزاء ،

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r3.claim: Kaffūr means one intensely unbelieving, namely a polytheist.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r4.speaker: الجمهور
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r4.claim: The majority read najzī with the first-person plural and accusative kulla.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r4.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور { نجزي } بنون العظمة ونصب { كل } .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r5.speaker: أبو عمرو
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r5.claim: Abū ʿAmr alone reads yujzā in the passive, with kulla as nominative subject.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p318/r5.anchor: وقرأه أبو عمرو وحده { يجزى } بياء الغائب والبناء للنائب ورفع { كل } .

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r3.claim: The contrast with the earlier mention of the chosen supports the interpretation that all three groups are in Paradise, since the disbelievers are mentioned only here.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r3.anchor: وهذا يؤيد تأويل من قال إن الأصناف الثلاثة هي كلها في الجنة لأن ذكر الكافرين إنما جاء هاهنا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r4.claim: The disbelievers are not killed off so that they would die and find relief; the statement that punishment is not eased does not conflict with the Fire sometimes subsiding, since its kind of punishment remains.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r4.anchor: وقوله لا يقضى معناه لا يجهز لأنهم لو ماتوا لبطلت حواسهم فاستراحوا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r5.speaker: الحسن البصري والثقفي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r5.claim: They read fa-yamūtūn, coordinating it with yuqḍā; Ibn ʿAṭiyya calls this reading weak.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r5.anchor: وقرأ الحسن البصري والثقفي «فيموتون» ووجهها العطف على يقضى وهي قراءة ضعيفة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r6.claim: The majority reads nanjzī with naṣb on kull; Abū ʿAmr and Nāfiʿ read passive yujzā, with kull nominative.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p440#2/r6.anchor: وقرأ جمهور القراء، «نجزي» بنصب «كل» وبالنون في «نجزي» ، وقرأ أبو عمرو ونافع «يجزى» بضم الياء

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p552#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p552#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p552#2/r1.claim: The deniers will not be put to death or have Hell's punishment reduced; the Qur'an and a sound Muslim report say its permanent inhabitants neither die nor live, while they plead for death and remain in torment.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p552#2/r1.anchor: كما قال تعالى: {لا يموت فيها ولا يحيا}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p552#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p552#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p552#2/r2.claim: This is the recompense for everyone who disbelieves in their Lord and denies the truth.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p552#2/r2.anchor: أي: هذا جزاء كل من كفر بربه وكذب بالحق

JISHUMI:v8p5854/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5854/r1.speaker: أبو عمرو
JISHUMI:v8p5854/r1.claim: Abu Amr reads يجزى passively, with كل nominative as the passive subject; other readers use the active form and make كل accusative, attributing the act to God.
JISHUMI:v8p5854/r1.anchor: قرأ أبو عمرو: يجزى بالياء وضمها وفتح الزاي، كل بالرفع على ما لم يسم فاعله

JISHUMI:v8p5854/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5854/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5854/r3.claim: Qaḍā and hukm are similar; qaḍā can mean finishing something completely or death as the completion of life.
JISHUMI:v8p5854/r3.anchor: القضاء: إتمام الشيء والفراغ منه على التمام

JISHUMI:v8p5854/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5854/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5854/r6.claim: جهنم is diptote though genitive as an annexed term; نعمل is jussive as the conditional answer, and يموتوا is subjunctive after the negation of حكم.
JISHUMI:v8p5854/r6.anchor: جهنم لا ينصرف، ومحله جر؛ لأنه مضاف إليه. نعمل جزم؛ لأنه جواب الشرط

JISHUMI:v8p5855/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5855/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5855/r1.claim: The unbelievers cannot die and find relief or have their suffering eased; varying intensity of the fire does not amount to relief from pain.
JISHUMI:v8p5855/r1.anchor: لا يحكم عليهم بالموت فيموتوا ويستريحوا ولا يخفف عنهم من عذابها بأن يقل العذاب

JISHUMI:v8p5855/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5855/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5855/r2.claim: The increase of the fire when it subsides is compatible with no easing of the pain: the flames rise and fall, but agony is never eased.
JISHUMI:v8p5855/r2.anchor: قلنا: التخفيف يحصل بتسهيل الآلام، وغير واقع ذلك، وإن كانت النار تارة تسعر، وتارة تخبو

QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r1.claim: After describing the people of Paradise, the passage turns to the people of Hell, their condition, and their speech.
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى: { والذين كفروا لهم نار جهنم } لما ذكر أهل الجنة وأحوالهم ومقالتهم، ذكر أهل النار وأحوالهم ومقالتهم.

QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r2.claim: The denial of death means they neither die nor live, as another verse states.
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r2.anchor: مثل: لا يموت فيها ولا يحيى [اطه: 74].

QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r3.claim: Their torment is never lightened, as the verse about repeatedly replacing their skins illustrates.
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r3.anchor: مثل: كلما نضجت جلودهم بدلناهم جلودا غيرها ليذوقوا العذاب [النساء: 56].

QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r4.claim: Every kafūr punished here means one who disbelieves in God and His messenger.
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r4.anchor: { كذلك نجزي كل كفور } أي كافر بالله ورسوله.

QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r5.speaker: الحسن
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r5.claim: He reads fa-yamūtūna with nūn; then it is coordinated with yuqḍā rather than serving as a subjunctive result of negation.
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r5.anchor: وقرأ الحسن «فيموتون» بالنون، ولا يكون للنفي حينئذ جواب،

QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r6.claim: On that reading the sense is that they are not sentenced to death and do not die, like the coordination in the verse about not being allowed to offer excuses.
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r6.anchor: ويكون «فيموتون» عطفا على «يقضى» تقديره لا يقضى عليهم ولا يموتون كقوله تعالى: { ولا يؤذن لهم فيعتذرون }.

QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r7.speaker: الكسائي
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r7.claim: Al-Kisāʾī explains the written nūn in the other verse as its end-of-verse position; either grammatical construction may be used for either clause.
QURTUBI-FULL:35:36-37/r7.anchor: قال الكسائي: { ولا يؤذن لهم فيعتذرون } بالنون في المصحف لأنه رأس آية

ZAJJAJ:v4p271/r1.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p271/r1.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p271/r1.claim: فيموتوا is subjunctive as the consequence of negation: they will not be sentenced to death and so die.
ZAJJAJ:v4p271/r1.anchor: (فيموتوا) نصب، وعلامة النصب سقوط النون، وهو جواب النفي.

STUDYQURAN:35:intro/r9.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:35:intro/r9.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:35:intro/r9.claim: The longest comparison of believers and disbelievers in verses 29–39 leads into a final contrast between God’s Power and idols, then the outcomes of disbelief.
STUDYQURAN:35:intro/r9.anchor: The longest comparison between the two groups (vv. 29–39), followed by a final contrast between the Power of God and that of the idols (vv. 40–41), segues into a final passage on the nature of disbelief and the ends to which it leads (vv. 42–45)

TAB-FULL:v19p382/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r1.claim: Disbelievers remain eternally in Hell, with no share in Paradise or its bliss.
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r1.anchor: لهم نار جهنم مخلدين فيها، لا حظ لهم في الجنة ولا نعيمها

TAB-FULL:v19p382/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r2.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r2.claim: Qatada says Hell's people are not put to death, since death would let them rest.
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r2.anchor: عن قتادة {لهم نار جهنم لا يقضى عليهم} [فاطر: 36] «بالموت فيموتوا، لأنهم لو ماتوا لاسترحوا»

TAB-FULL:v19p382/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r3.speaker: أبو السوداء عن قتادة
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r3.claim: Abū al-Sawdāʾ reports Qatada's saying that the people of Hell are pitiable because they do not die and rest.
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r3.anchor: عن أبي السوداء، قال: «مساكين أهل النار لا يموتون

TAB-FULL:v19p382/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r4.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r4.claim: The Prophet distinguishes permanent inhabitants of Hell, who neither die nor live, from sinners who die in the fire, then are interceded for and revived in Paradise like a seed after floodwater.
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r4.anchor: عن أبي نضرة، عن أبي سعيد، قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: " أما أهل النار الذين هم أهلها فإنهم لا يموتون فيها ولا يحيون

TAB-FULL:v19p382/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r5.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r5.claim: The statement that Hell's punishment is not eased means this kind of torment is not eased by putting its sufferers to death, despite 17:97 describing flames that intensify when they abate.
TAB-FULL:v19p382/r5.anchor: معنى ذلك: ولا يخفف عنهم من هذا النوع من العذاب

TAB-FULL:v19p384/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p384/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v19p384/r1.claim: God repays every denier of his blessings by placing them in Hell for the sins they committed in worldly life.
TAB-FULL:v19p384/r1.anchor: هؤلاء الكفار يستغيثون، ويضجون في النار، يقولون: يا ربنا أخرجنا نعمل صالحا

TABRISI:35:36-37/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:35:36-37/r1.speaker: author
TABRISI:35:36-37/r1.claim: Abu Amr and Khalaf alone read the passive yujzā kullu kafūr; other readers use active najzī with kull as its object.
TABRISI:35:36-37/r1.anchor: قرأ أبو عمر وخلف وحده يجزي كل كفور على ما لم يسم فاعله

TABRISI:35:36-37/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:35:36-37/r5.speaker: author
TABRISI:35:36-37/r5.claim: The disbelievers do not die and find relief, nor is the Fire’s punishment eased; this is how every persistent denier of God and His prophets is requited.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:35:34-37/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:35:34-37/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:35:34-37/r3.claim: The disbelievers remain in Hell without being put to death and released.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:35:34-37/r3.anchor: { والذين كفروا لهم نار جهنم لا يقضى عليهم فيموتوا }.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r7.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r7.speaker: السدي
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r7.claim: Al-Suddī explains that death does not descend upon the people of Hell so that they die.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r7.anchor: تفسير السدي: يعني: لا ينزل بهم الموت فيموتوا.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r8.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r8.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r8.claim: Yaḥyā links the promise that their punishment will not be lightened to the statement that they will only be increased in punishment.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r8.anchor: وقال في آية أخرى: {فذوقوا فلن نزيدكم إلا عذابا}

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r9.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r9.speaker: عبد الله بن عمرو
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r9.claim: Qatāda reports that ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAmr used to say that no verse about the people of Hell was more severe than this one.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r9.anchor: أخبرنا سعيد، عن قتادة أن عبد الله بن عمرو كان يقول: ما نزل في أهل النار آية هي أشد من هذه.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r10.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r10.speaker: قتادة
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r10.claim: Qatāda explains ‘every ungrateful denier’ as everyone who disbelieves in his Lord.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p793/r10.anchor: حدثنا سعيد، عن قتادة، قال: {كذلك نجزي كل كفور} [فاطر: 36] كل كفور بربه.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:35:36/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:35:36/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:35:36/r1.claim: Unbelievers who dismissed worldly warnings plead for another chance when faced with punishment, but their cries do no good; compare 23:107–108.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:35:36/r1.anchor: dünyada iken yapılan uyarıları hafife alan inkârcıların kötü âkıbetle karşılaştıklarında kendilerine yeni bir fırsat verilmesi için çırpınmaları tasvir edilir

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p305/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p305/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p305/r3.claim: Wealth and children neither prove divine favor nor unworthiness; God expands or constricts provision with wisdom, testing gratitude or patience, and true success appears in the Hereafter.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p305/r3.anchor: this abundance and paucity is based on God’s authority and wisdom.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p306/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p306/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p306/r1.claim: The Arabic word ḍiʿf should not be read as meaning only a double reward.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p306/r1.anchor: should not be construed as two times or double reward.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p307/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p307/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p307/r1.claim: The repeated opening about provision has different force: verse 36 stresses God's control and the test of gratitude or patience, so people should neither boast nor despair.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p307/r1.anchor: Verse 36 explains that the abundance in sustenance and their scarcity is totally in the hands of God.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p361/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p361/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p361/r1.claim: Those who denied God’s Book at the time of revelation likewise deserve the punishment already described, connecting the discourse to its original setting.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p361/r1.anchor: This statement has linked the discourse to the situation that existed at the time of its revelation

SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r1.speaker: العامة
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r1.claim: The common subjunctive drops نون as a response to negation: no judgment means no consequent death; the alternative sense of arrival without conversation does not fit this verse.
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r1.anchor: العامة على نصبه بحذف النون جوابا للنفي. وهو على أحد معنيي نصب " ما تأتينا فتحدثنا "

SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r2.claim: The other possible subjunctive meaning affirms arrival but denies conversation, and is impossible here.
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r2.anchor: والمعنى الثاني: إثبات الإتيان ونفي الحديث أي: ما تأتينا محدثا بل تأتينا غير محدث. وهذا لا يجوز في الآية البتة.

SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r3.speaker: عيسى والحسن
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r3.claim: Isa and al-Hasan retain نون in فيموتون; Ibn Atiyya calls it weak, while al-Mazini coordinates it with لا يقضى عليهم, negating judgment and death.
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r3.anchor: وقرأ عيسى والحسن " فيموتون " بإثبات النون. قال ابن عطية: " هي ضعيفة ". قلت: وقد وجهها المازني على العطف على

SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r4.claim: The raised reading can negate both events, like ولا يؤذن لهم فيعتذرون: they will not be allowed and will not make excuses.
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r4.anchor: وهو أحد الوجهين في معنى الرفع في قولك: " ما تأتينا فتحدثنا " أي: انتفاء الأمرين معا، كقوله: ولا يؤذن لهم فيعتذرون

SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r5.claim: عليهم is deputy subject in لا يقضى and عنهم likewise after يخفف; alternatively من عذابها is deputy subject and عنهم accusative, or من is extra per al-Akhfash.
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r5.anchor: و " عليهم " قائم مقام الفاعل، وكذلك " عنهم " بعد " يخفف ". ويجوز أن يكون القائم " من عذابها " و " عنهم " منصوب المحل.

SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r6.speaker: أبو عمرو
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r6.claim: In one transmission Abu Amr reads يخفف with silent فاء, assimilating across a word boundary like عضد; an anonymous line illustrates أشرب.
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r6.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو في رواية " ولا يخفف " بسكون الفاء، شبه المنفصل ب " عضد " كقوله:

SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r7.claim: كذلك is nominative as an omitted الأمر كذلك or accusative meaning مثل ذلك الجزاء.
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r7.anchor: قوله: " كذلك " إما مرفوع المحل أي: الأمر كذلك، وإما منصوبه أي: مثل ذلك الجزاء نجزي.

SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r8.speaker: أبو عمرو
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r8.claim: Abu Amr reads يجزى passively with كل nominative; others read active نجزي with كل as object.
SAMIN-DURR:35:36/r8.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو " يجزى " مبنيا للمفعول، " كل " رفع به. والباقون " نجزي " بنون العظمة مبنيا للفاعل

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p27/r1.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p27/r1.speaker: أبو عمرو
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p27/r1.claim: Abū ʿAmr reads the passive يجزى with كل كفور nominative; the clause ولا يخفف عنهم supports this passive expression.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p27/r1.anchor: فقرأ أبو عمرو، وكذلك يجزى* بالياء كل كفور رفع.

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p27/r2.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p27/r2.speaker: الباقون
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p27/r2.claim: The other readers have active نجزى with كل كفور accusative; the first-person plural aligns with أولم نعمركم in 35:37.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p27/r2.anchor: وقرأ الباقون: نجزى بالنون كل كفور نصبا .

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p27/r3.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p27/r3.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p27/r3.claim: Al-Fārisī says the passive يجزى is equivalent in meaning to active نجزي; he compares فزع عن قلوبهم and فزع, and يجازى and نجازي.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p27/r3.anchor: ويجزى* في المعنى مثل نجزي، ومثله: فزع عن قلوبهم وفزع*

QIRAAT-ER:35:36:21#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:35:36:21#1/r1.speaker: Imp|Pss|CE
QIRAAT-ER:35:36:21#1/r1.claim: The passive yujzā kullu changes first-person active najzī kulla to “every denier is recompensed,” making kullu the nominative subject.
QIRAAT-ER:35:36:21#1/r1.anchor: Imp|Pss|CE, mutawatir: "Canonical passive phrase changes najzī kulla to ""every kafūr is recompensed

ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r1.claim: They are not sentenced to a second death that would let them escape the Fire's punishment altogether.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r1.anchor: أي لا يحكم عليهم بموت ثان ( فيموتوا ( ليستريحوا بذلك من عذابها بالكلية

ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r2.claim: He explains this as no death sentence, rather than simply no dying, to avoid redundancy or a gloss of rest.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r2.anchor: وإنما فسر لا يقضى بماذكر دون لا يموتون لئلا يلغوا فيموتوا ويحتاج إلى تأويله بيستريحوا

ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r3.claim: The subjunctive follows negation through implied أن; the sentence denies the cause and so denies death as its result.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r3.anchor: ونصب يموتوا في جواب النفي بإضمار أن والمراد إنتفاء المسبب لإنتفاء السبب

ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r4.speaker: عيسى والحسن
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r4.claim: Isa and al-Hasan read فيموتون with nūn, coordinating it with يقضى: they are neither sentenced to death nor die.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r4.anchor: وقرأ عيسى والحسن ( فيموتون ) بالنون عطفا كما قال أبو عثمان المازني على ( يقضى )

ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r5.claim: He compares the coordination to the verse saying people are not allowed to speak and so cannot make excuses.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r5.anchor: كقوله تعالى : ( لا يؤذن لهم فيعتذرون ) أي لا يقضى عليهم ولا يموتون

ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r6.claim: Their punishment is never eased; whenever the Fire subsides it is stoked again, and this permanence does not exclude cold or other torment.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r6.anchor: بل كلما خبت زيد إسعارها والمراد دوام العذاب فلا ينافي تعذيبهم بالزمهرير ونحوه

ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r7.claim: For passive يخفف, عنهم may be the deputy subject and من عذابها accusative, or their roles may be reversed.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r7.anchor: ونائب فاعل يخفف ( عنهم ) ومن عذابها في موضع نصب ويجوز العكس

ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r8.speaker: أبو البقاء
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r8.claim: If من is extra, its genitive object must be raised as the passive verb's deputy subject.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r8.anchor: وجوز أن تكون من زائدة فيتعين رفع مجرورها على أنه النائب عن الفاعل على ما قال أبو البقاء

ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r9.speaker: عبدالوارث عن أبي عمرو
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r9.claim: Abd al-Warith from Abu Amr reads يخفف with a still fāʾ, treating the separated form like a connected one; he cites a poetic parallel.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r9.anchor: وقرأ عبدالوارث عن أبي عمرو ( ولا يخفف ) بإسكان الفاء شبه المنفصل بالمتصل كقوله

ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r10.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r10.claim: Thus is the terrible recompense given to every emphatic disbeliever or ingrate; no lesser recompense is meant.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r10.anchor: ( كذلك أي مثل ذلك الجزاء الفظيع نجزي كل كفور 63 ( مبالغ في الكفر أو الكفران لا جزاء أخف

ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r11.speaker: أبو عمرو وأبو حاتم عن نافع
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r11.claim: They read يجزي passively with yāʾ and كل in the nominative as deputy subject.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r11.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو وأبو حاتم عن نافع ( يجزي ) بالياء مبنيا للمفعول و ( كل ) بالرفع على النيابة عن الفاعل

ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r12.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r12.claim: Another reading is نُجازي, with a damma on nūn and an alif after jīm.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p200/r12.anchor: وقريء ( نجازي ) بنون مضمومة وألف بعد الجيم

BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r6.claim: No second death is decreed for unbelievers, so they cannot gain release by dying.

BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r7.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r7.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r7.claim: The subjunctive “so they die” has an implied أن.

BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r8.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r8.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r8.claim: A variant reads the verb in the indicative, coordinated with “is decreed.”

BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r9.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r9.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r9.claim: Their torment is never eased; whenever the Fire subsides, its blaze increases.

BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r10.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r10.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r10.claim: Every kāfūr is excessive in disbelief or ingratitude.

BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r11.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r11.speaker: أبو عمرو
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r11.claim: Abū ʿAmr reads the verb passively, making “every unbeliever” its subject; another variant reads يُجازى.
BAYDAWI-FULL:35:34-36/r11.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو «يجزى» على بناء المفعول

BIQAI-FULL:v6p227/r18.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p227/r18.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p227/r18.claim: The disbelievers are those who concealed the clear signs their reason disclosed and treated God's allies and callers to Him with arrogance.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p227/r18.anchor: ما دلت عليه عقولهم من شموس الآيات

BIQAI-FULL:v6p227/r19.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p227/r19.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p227/r19.claim: Unlike ordinary fire, Hell does not finish them off by a ruling that brings death, increasing their punishment.

BIQAI-FULL:v6p227/r20.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p227/r20.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p227/r20.claim: They neither die nor receive any easing of Hell's punishment.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p227/r20.anchor: لا يحكم وينفذ ويثبت من حاكم ما

DURR-FULL:v7p26/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p26/r5.speaker: كعب الأحبار
DURR-FULL:v7p26/r5.claim: Kaʿb argues that the following mention of Hell's people refers to the disbelievers, supporting his claim that all inheritors are in Paradise.
DURR-FULL:v7p26/r5.anchor: ألا ترى على أثره (والذين كفروا لهم نار جهنم) فهؤلاء أهل النار

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r4.claim: Contrasting the three groups who inherited the Book with disbelievers confirms those groups are believers; the different rewards show that paradise belongs to all three, with differences of time and place.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r4.anchor: مقابلة الأقسام الثلاثة للذين أورثوا الكتاب بذكر الكافرين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r5.claim: The statement that their punishment is not lightened hints that the fire punishing sinful believers is lighter than that of the polytheists.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r5.anchor: إيماء إلى أن نار عقاب المؤمنين خفيفة عن نار المشركين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r6.claim: The disbelievers clause coordinates with the statement that they enter gardens of permanence.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r6.anchor: معطوفة على جملة { جنات عدن يدخلونها }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r7.claim: The lām in لهم marks deservingness, showing that Hell was prepared as recompense for their deeds; the author cites the warnings in al-Baqara and Āl ʿImrān and says the fire for sinful believers is distinct or belongs to the disbelievers.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r7.anchor: بلام الاستحقاق للدلالة على أنها أعدت لجزاء أعمالهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r8.claim: Putting لهم first creates anticipation for the mention of Hell, allowing the completed meaning to settle in listeners’ minds.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r8.anchor: على المسند إليه للتشويق إلى ذكر المسند إليه حتى إذا سمعه السامعون

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r9.claim: The clause that they are not brought to death is an explicative substitute for the Hell statement; qaḍāʾ can literally mean judgment or God’s decree and can also mean causing death.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r9.anchor: حقيقته الحكم ، ومنه قضاء الله حكمه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r10.claim: On the literal reading, God does not decree their death, so they do not die; this reading accords with their plea to Malik and the answer that they remain.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r10.anchor: محتمل للحقيقة ، أي لا يقدر الله موتهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r11.claim: On the figurative reading, qaḍāʾ means death, but they undergo only its pains and no relief: renewed skin lets them keep tasting the punishment.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v22p316/r11.anchor: فيفيد أنهم يماتون موتا ليس فيه من الموت إلا آلامه دون راحته

BURSEVI:v7p277/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p277/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p277/r1.claim: The disbelievers are those who deny God's existence or His oneness.
BURSEVI:v7p277/r1.anchor: جحدوا بوجود الله تعالى أو بوحدته

BURSEVI:v7p277/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p277/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p277/r2.claim: Hellfire is the recompense for their disbelief, the greatest of sins and ugliest of acts, and is unlike ordinary fire.
BURSEVI:v7p277/r2.anchor: بمقابلة كفرهم الذي هو أكبر الكبائر وأقبح القبائح

BURSEVI:v7p277/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p277/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p277/r3.claim: They are not sentenced to a second death that would let them escape and rest from torment.

BURSEVI:v7p277/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p277/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p277/r4.claim: Fayamutū is subjunctive through an implicit an because it answers a negation.
BURSEVI:v7p277/r4.anchor: ونصبه بإضمار ان لأنه جواب النفي

BURSEVI:v7p277/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p277/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p277/r5.claim: Their punishment is not lightened for even an instant; whenever the fire subsides, its blazing is increased.
BURSEVI:v7p277/r5.anchor: طرفه عين بل كلما خبت زيد استعارها يعني : (هركاه كه آتش فرونشيند زياده كنند احراق والتهاب اورا)

BURSEVI:v7p277/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p277/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p277/r6.claim: Kashf al-asrar explains that the fire's temporary diminution is not a lessening of their punishment, since it is then increased again.
BURSEVI:v7p277/r6.anchor: قوله كلما خبت لا يدل على تخفيف عنهم بل على نقصان في النار ثم يزداد

BURSEVI:v7p277/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p277/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p277/r7.claim: The syntax permits ʿanhum to be the نائب الفاعل with min ʿadhābihā in the accusative, or the reverse; if min is redundant, the latter must be nominative.
BURSEVI:v7p277/r7.anchor: قوله عنهم نائب مناب الفاعل ومن عذابها في موقع النصب أو بالعكس وإن كانت زائدة يتعين له الرفع

BURSEVI:v7p277/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p277/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p277/r8.claim: This is the pattern of such a dreadful punishment: no lighter or lesser recompense is given to every intense disbeliever or ingrate.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p493#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p493#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p493#2/r1.claim: They are not destroyed and thereby relieved of their torment; the same expression occurs of Moses killing a man.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p493#2/r1.anchor: ﴿ لا يقضى عليهم فيموتوا ﴾ أي لايهلكون فيستريحوا مما هم فيه ومثله

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p493#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p493#2/r2.speaker: أبو عمرو، الباقون
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p493#2/r2.claim: Abū ʿAmr reads yajzī with yāʾ and nominative kull; the other readers have najzī with nūn and accusative kull.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p493#2/r2.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو يجزي بالياء كل برفع اللام وقرأ الباقون نجزي بالنون كل بنصب اللام

JISHUMI:v1p675/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p675/r1.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v1p675/r1.claim: The question whether repenting of one sin but not another is valid is answered in two ways: the discussion may concern deserving a curse or deserving punishment.
JISHUMI:v1p675/r1.anchor: قلنا: فيه قولان: الأول: قيل في استحقاق اللعنة، وقيل في العذاب

JISHUMI:v1p675/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p675/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v1p675/r2.claim: Punishment can be lightened by reducing its amount, lessening its severity, or interrupting it; the verse covers all three, though reduction is likeliest because eternal duration already implies continuity.
JISHUMI:v1p675/r2.anchor: التخفيف في العذاب من ثلاثة أوجه: إذا كان العذاب بالكثرة فتخفيفه بالنقصان

JISHUMI:v1p675/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p675/r3.speaker: القاضي
JISHUMI:v1p675/r3.claim: Seeing another person receive greater punishment cannot ease one’s own, since the punished are wholly consumed by their torment and relative differences do not affect them.
JISHUMI:v1p675/r3.anchor: عن القاضي، وقيل: إن كل واحد مدفوع إلى عذاب يظنه أعظم

JISHUMI:v1p675/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p675/r4.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v1p675/r4.claim: Another view says that each person is driven to a punishment he believes to be greater than the others’ punishment.
JISHUMI:v1p675/r4.anchor: وقيل: إن كل واحد مدفوع إلى عذاب يظنه أعظم

JISHUMI:v1p675/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p675/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v1p675/r5.claim: The author prefers the view that differences in others’ punishment do not relieve a person’s own torment.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r1.claim: The fāʾ in “so that they die” answers the negation and is subjunctive with an implicit an.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r1.anchor: فيموتوا } جواب النفي ، ونصبه بإضمار أن

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r2.claim: A variant reads “they die” in the nominative, coordinating it with “judgment is passed” and including it in the negation; compare the verse about not being allowed to speak.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r3.claim: “Like that” means with that kind of recompense.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p624#2/r4.claim: The passage has variants with yujāzā and nujzī; nujzī uses first-person nūn.

MUQATIL:35:34-36/r7.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:35:34-36/r7.speaker: author
MUQATIL:35:34-36/r7.claim: The unbelievers are those who disbelieved in God’s oneness.
MUQATIL:35:34-36/r7.anchor: والذين كفروا } بتوحيد الله { لهم نار جهنم

MUQATIL:35:34-36/r8.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:35:34-36/r8.speaker: author
MUQATIL:35:34-36/r8.claim: They neither die nor have punishment eased; this is how God repays every rejecter of faith.
MUQATIL:35:34-36/r8.anchor: كذلك } هكذا { نجزي كل كفور } [آية: 36] بالإيمان

NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r1.claim: The verb after negation is subjunctive by an omitted an; no second death is decreed that could give them rest.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r1.anchor: جواب النفى ونصبه باضمار أن أى لا يقضى عليهم بموت ثان فيستريحوا

NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r2.claim: Their punishment in Hell is not lightened.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r2.anchor: ﴿ ولا يخفف عنهم من عذابها ﴾ من عذاب نار جهنم

NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r3.claim: Likewise refers to that same punishment, the recompense for every ingrate.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r3.anchor: من عذاب نار جهنم كذلك مثل ذلك الجزاء

NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r4.speaker: أبو عمرو
NASAFI-FULL:v3p345/r4.claim: Abu Amr reads the verb in the passive with ya: every ingrate is recompensed.

QASHANI:35:34-36/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:35:34-36/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:35:34-36/r4.claim: The disbelievers are those veiled from the addressee by denial, who reject and do not inherit the Book because they are truly distant from him, with no closeness or connection.
QASHANI:35:34-36/r4.anchor: المحجوبون منك بالإنكار، الذين لا يقبلون الكتاب ولا يرثونه لبعدهم عنك في الحقيقة

QASHANI:35:34-36/r5.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:35:34-36/r5.speaker: author
QASHANI:35:34-36/r5.claim: Their fire is the hell of nature, where they suffer unending deprivation and pain, with neither death to relieve them nor easing of torment.
QASHANI:35:34-36/r5.anchor: الطبيعة يعذبون فيها بأنواع الحرمان والآلام دائما

RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r1.claim: This warning is linked by conjunction to the promise for those who recite God's Book; the intervening passage concerns those reciters, and on one view the mention of gardens of Eden also refers back to them.
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r1.anchor: وما بينهما كلام يتعلق بالذين يتلون كتاب الله

RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r2.claim: They are not allowed the relief of death; their punishment continues without end.
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r2.anchor: أي لا يستريحون بالموت بل العذاب دائم

RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r3.claim: Unlike worldly pain, the afterlife's torment neither kills its victims nor becomes familiar to a body until it is no longer felt; it remains severe at every moment and the punished remain in it.
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r3.anchor: بل هو في كل زمان شديد والمعذب فيه دائم

RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r4.claim: The sequence stresses that torment is neither ended nor eased: even death, its strongest possible end, is withheld, so they will wish for death without receiving it.
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r4.anchor: لا ينقطع ولا بأقوى الأسباب وهو الموت حتى يتمنون الموت ولا يجابون

RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p26#2/r5.claim: For the punished, it is enough to say their torment will not diminish; by contrast, the blessed are promised an increase from God's bounty.

STUDYQURAN:35:36/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:35:36/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:35:36/r1.claim: The statement that the condemned do not die resembles 20:74, which says the guilty neither die nor live in Hell.
STUDYQURAN:35:36/r1.anchor: They will neither be done away with so as to die is similar to 20:74

STUDYQURAN:35:36/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:35:36/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:35:36/r2.claim: Punishment is not eased after sentence because disbelievers already received worldly respite and repeated opportunities to repent; related passages likewise deny relief or respite.
STUDYQURAN:35:36/r2.anchor: they had already been granted respite and thus had many opportunities to repent during the life of this world

STUDYQURAN:35:36/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:35:36/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:35:36/r3.claim: God promises that whenever the punishment abates, the disbelievers will receive an increase of blazing flame.
STUDYQURAN:35:36/r3.anchor: Every time it abates, We shall increase for them a blazing flame (17:97; cf. 78:30)

TABATABAI:35:33-36/r11.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:35:33-36/r11.speaker: author
TABATABAI:35:33-36/r11.claim: The lām in lahum marks exclusive assignment: Hell is their recompense and remains inseparable from them.
TABATABAI:35:33-36/r11.anchor: اللام في { لهم } للاختصاص ويفيد كون النار جزاء لهم لا ينفك عنهم

TABATABAI:35:33-36/r12.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:35:33-36/r12.speaker: author
TABATABAI:35:33-36/r12.claim: They are not sentenced to death, so they remain alive amid their severe torment, which is not lightened.
TABATABAI:35:33-36/r12.anchor: لا يحكم عليهم بالموت حتى يموتوا فهم أحياء على ما هم فيه من شدة العذاب ولا يخفف عنهم من عذاب النار

TABATABAI:35:33-36/r13.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:35:33-36/r13.speaker: author
TABATABAI:35:33-36/r13.claim: Kafūr describes one extreme in denying or one who denies repeatedly.

THALABI:v8p113#2/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p113#2/r1.speaker: author
THALABI:v8p113#2/r1.claim: The people of Hell are not put to death so that they could rest.
THALABI:v8p113#2/r1.anchor: لا يقضى عليهم فيموتوا أي لا يقبضون فيستريحون.

THALABI:v8p113#2/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p113#2/r2.speaker: الحسن
THALABI:v8p113#2/r2.claim: Al-Hasan construes the clause as saying they are neither sentenced to death nor die; here the lā before die is not a result clause, as in 77:36.
THALABI:v8p113#2/r2.anchor: وذكر عن الحسن: فيموتون، و (لا) يكون حينئذ جوابا للنفي، والمعنى: لا يقضى عليهم ولا يموتون. كقوله:

THALABI:v8p113#2/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p113#2/r3.speaker: العامة
THALABI:v8p113#2/r3.claim: The common reading has the subject first-person plural, with the final nūn and lām in the accusative as described by the source.

THALABI:v8p113#2/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p113#2/r4.speaker: أبو عمرو
THALABI:v8p113#2/r4.claim: Abu Amr reads the verb in the passive, with ḍamma on yāʾ and lām and fatḥ on zāy.
THALABI:v8p113#2/r4.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو بضم الياء واللام وفتح الزاي على غير تسمية الفاعل

WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r1.claim: The description of the people of monotheism, the community of Muḥammad, ends here; the passage now describes the disbelievers.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r1.anchor: فلما بلغ هذا الموضع انقطعت صفة أهل التوحيد، وهم أمة محمد -صلى الله عليه وسلم-، ثم قال في صفة الكفار

WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r2.speaker: أبو إسحاق
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r2.claim: Abū Isḥāq parses femūtū as the response to the negation: death is not decreed for them so that they might die.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r2.anchor: قال أبو إسحاق: فيموتوا جواب النفي، المعنى: لا يقضى عليهم الموت فيموتوا

WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r3.claim: Alternatively, lā yuqḍā ʿalayhim can mean they are not destroyed, as in Moses striking a man and killing him (28:15); this reading needs no omitted word.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r3.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون معنى لا يقضى عليهم لا يهلكون، من قوله: {فوكزه موسى فقضى عليه}

WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says they would die and find relief from the torment they endure.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r4.anchor: قال ابن عباس: فيموتوا فيستريحوا مما (¬9) هم فيه من العذاب

WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r5.claim: Their punishment is not lightened for even the blink of an eye.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r5.anchor: {ولا يخفف عنهم من عذابها} طرفة عين كذلك يعن ما ذكر

WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r6.speaker: ابن عباس ومقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r6.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās and Muqātil gloss every kafūr as every disbeliever.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p431/r6.anchor: وقال ابن عباس ومقاتل: هكذا نجزي كل كفور كل كافر

BURHAN:v2p421/r4.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p421/r4.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p421/r4.claim: Perpetual negation can be expressed with لا as well, so eternal force does not belong uniquely to لن.
BURHAN:v2p421/r4.anchor: وقد استعملت لا للاستغراق الابدي فى قوله تعالى

BURHAN:v1p307/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p307/r5.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p307/r5.claim: After negation, deleting nūn can negate both the event and its result; retaining nūn marks coordination, distinguishing the two constructions in these verses.
BURHAN:v1p307/r5.anchor: حذف النون جوابا للنفى هو على أحد معنى نصب ما تأتينا فتحدثنا أى ما يكون إتيان ولا حديث

NASHR:v2p351/r5.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p351/r5.speaker: أبو عمرو
NASHR:v2p351/r5.claim: Abū ʿAmr reads كذلك يجزي with yāʾ, ḍamma, fatḥ on zāy, and nominative كل; the others read with nūn, fatḥ, kasra on zāy, and accusative كل.
NASHR:v2p351/r5.anchor: فقرأ أبو عمرو بالياء وضمها وفتح الزاي
